## 1 - 6 Continued

In filling extra-curricular positions, the principal shall normally choose bargaining unit employees over non-bargaining unit employees, and when selecting a bargaining unit employee, shall normally choose one assigned to the principal's building during the regular school day or one who is assigned elsewhere. Should the principal choose a non-bargaining unit employee for an extra-curricular position for which one or more bargaining employees have applied, the principal shall inform the bargaining unit employee(s) as to the reasons, but only when requested to do so by the bargaining unit employee(s). The reason(s) shall be either verbal or written based upon the employee's request.

If neither the School Board nor the Coordinator of Athletics have ordered a principal not to fill a certain position listed in the collective bargaining agreement, and yet the principal has chosen not to fill the position, a teacher, parent, or student may appeal to the Coordinator of Athletics.
